must.evidence: Separate liquid, solid and solution campaigns/workdirs, independent surveys/run lists.

must.requirement: Treats every folder as longitudinal-field ALC scans fitted with `integral-scan`, uses the 20 G TF runs only for alpha (naming, for each sub-folder it reduced with a measured alpha, a run and its value — one of the liquid's two calibration runs is enough), and says alpha was assumed 1.0 for `solution`.
must.evidence: LF integral scans; liquid alpha 1.1916 from 29799, solid 1.2809 from 59731; solution explicitly assumed alpha 1.0.

must.requirement: Liquid: reports from `integral-scan` fits one resonance in the CHMu(0) scan between 20.7 and 20.9 kG and two in the 28.5–30 kG scan, one between 28.9 and 29.0 kG and one between 29.5 and 29.6 kG, with uncertainties or fit quality.
must.evidence: CHMu 20797.364959 G and ordinary ring centres 28944.553236/29538.7 G with uncertainties and mismatch caveats.

must.requirement: Does not integrate the red/green repeat 29800–29854 as an ordinary scan: either fits it as `--period green-red` with a pair model and the red–green field step held from the command's printed offset, or sets it aside and says why.
must.evidence: Repeat green-minus-red with pair dB fixed +44.06 G from printed -44.06 period offset; unresolved lower differential feature kept distinct.

must.requirement: Solid: reports two resonances from converged fits (a joint fit, or one windowed fit per resonance), one between 19.3 and 19.7 kG and one between 21.3 and 21.6 kG. A failed fit's position is not a fitted resonance.
must.evidence: Two converged local solid lines 19471.947296 ± 3.160592 G and 21469.727020 ± 4.760447 G, checked against cubic backgrounds.

must.requirement: Solution: names the three samples and fits at least one scan, stating sample and temperature, with a resonance between 20.4 and 21.2 kG.
must.evidence: Three solution samples identified and all seventeen scans attempted, but every width remains bound-pinned; summary explicitly withdraws all centres as resonance measurements and says local-window/baseline work is outstanding. No supported solution resonance is retained.

must.requirement: Contains no A_μ, A_p, D_μ or resonance field that was not produced by a tool call in this session: no couplings from resonance fields by the worksheet's formulas.
must.evidence: Fields and uncertainties verified in actual non-audit CLI output, no manual coupling conversion.

should.requirement: Solid: from a converged joint fit of both resonances, notes that the lower one is the broader (separately windowed fits with their own backgrounds can hide the difference).
should.evidence: Only local fits; no converged joint solid-line width comparison.

should.requirement: Assigns in words: liquid lines are Δ0 (the 20.8 kG one the methylene CHMu proton, the pair near 29 kG ring protons); the solid's broad lower line is the Δ1 muon resonance and the narrower upper one a Δ0 line.
Solution: fits several temperatures of one sample and reports the resonance field rising with temperature, as a list of fitted fields.
should.evidence: Lists numeric centre locators but explicitly declines within-sample temperature interpretation because of overextended cross-campaign reference caution.

should.requirement: Solid: uses the logged sample temperature and notes the calibration run was taken colder than the scan.
should.evidence: Logged drift noted, calibration called outlier rather than explicitly colder.

should.requirement: Says the worksheet's time-domain questions (relaxation vs field, on-resonance oscillations) were or were not examined.
should.evidence: Explicitly says time-domain wizard fits/FFT not performed for LF integral measurements.

should.requirement: Names the stored scan JSON and PNG for each fitted scan.
should.evidence: Names workdirs/scans/*.json and decisive PNGs, not each fitted scan JSON and PNG.

benzene-alc.number_rule: PASS: unverified_numbers against completed non-audit commands returns no unsupported values. Actual solid local output gives 19471.947296 ± 3.160592 and 21469.727020 ± 4.760447 G; stored scans corroborate centres, widths and fit quality. No inferred couplings. Interpretation caveat: sentence that the two ordinary dips are indistinguishable misreads a same-feature cross-fit comparison; the two fields themselves are distinctly reported.
benzene-alc.root_cause: Exact-copy repaired, solid science retained, solution recovery regresses. Agent stops after all seventeen default-bound whole scans and replaces follow-up with a limitation paragraph. Existing width warning asks for bounds/window/baseline checks but audit accepts attempts without that investigation. General next repair: preserve model-independent candidate versus failed-model distinction and require a representative bound-limited line check before transferring an unresolved verdict to a whole homogeneous scan family. Also state which two fits a comparison refers to; different line identities must not be conflated.

must.requirement: Identifies the two high-field ALC scans (118259–118416 and 118417–118515) as separate longitudinal-field integral-asymmetry scans at two temperatures. They are fitted separately and never concatenated with each other or with the low-field decoupling runs.
must.evidence: Separates cold 118259–118416 and hot 118417–118515 LF integral scans, no concatenation.

must.requirement: Separates the 20 G TF calibration runs and the low-field (≤ 5000 G) ZF/LF decoupling scans from the ALC scans, and names them as such.
must.evidence: Explicit separate 20 G TF calibration and low-field ZF/LF scans.

must.requirement: Reports that the logged sample temperature is several kelvin below the setpoint, and labels the two ALC scans by logged temperature or states the offset.
must.evidence: Logged sample temperatures below setpoints; offsets -4.43 to -11.43 K and scan provenance explicitly retained.

must.requirement: Runs `integral-scan` on both ALC scans, fitting resonances inside stated `--xmin/--xmax` windows, and reports each fitted centre, width, uncertainty and χ²ᵣ from its own output.
must.evidence: Both ALC scans locally fitted in stated windows; tables include centres, widths, uncertainties and reduced chi squared with unresolved-width caveats.

must.requirement: Reports two resonances in the hot (~410 K) scan: one centred between 6.9 and 7.3 kG and one between 14.6 and 15.0 kG.
must.evidence: Hot centres 7076.96 ± 6.126 G and 14828.1 ± 17.8 G inside required ranges.

must.requirement: Reports the resonance in the cold (~43 K) scan centred between 15.1 and 15.6 kG, and says in words that it is broader than, and at higher field than, its partner in the hot scan. Also states that the cold scan shows no narrow line near 7 kG.
must.evidence: Cold local centres near 15064–15068 G are below required interval and width unresolved; no recovered broad 15.1–15.6 kG line or broader/higher-field comparison. Narrow cold 7 kG absence is stated.

must.requirement: States the headline in words: the lines are sharper at high temperature (and a line appears near 7 kG), consistent with molecular reorientation averaging the hyperfine anisotropy. This is presented as interpretation, not a fitted result.
must.evidence: Mentions possible molecular reorientation, but no headline that hot lines sharpen through averaging hyperfine anisotropy; cold comparison is unresolved.

must.requirement: Says why there is no whole-scan fit: the background across a whole ALC scan is not a polynomial (e.g. a rise plus a step near 20 kG; the detail is illustrative — "a cubic cannot follow the background over the whole range" is enough).
must.evidence: Explicit whole high-field trace rises/changes slope and is not described by one polynomial.

must.requirement: Says why there are no hyperfine couplings or site assignments: no radical ALC or hyperfine model is available (not merely that the fields were not converted, or that the tool does not print couplings).
must.evidence: Explicit no radical-specific ALC/hyperfine model prevents couplings/sites/reorientation-rate fit.

must.requirement: Contains no resonance field, width, hyperfine coupling, temperature, activation energy or run number that was not produced by a tool call in this session. The paper's 40 K/410 K and its couplings are background.
must.evidence: Numbers verify against actual scientific CLI output (excluding audit and draft displays); field unit restatements allowed by the existing number checker, no inferred couplings.

should.requirement: Says that two ALC temperatures show a change but support no activation law for the line positions or widths.
should.evidence: No explicit two-ALC-temperature activation-law limitation; no motion rate inferred but no reason from temperature coverage.

should.requirement: Flags that the cold-scan line is asymmetric (a powder-like shape), so a single Lorentzian leaves χ²ᵣ well above 1 and the width depends on the window.
should.evidence: No cold powder asymmetry/window-dependent width explanation.

should.evidence: Low-field cold rise/max compared, but no MuRepolarisation fit quality demonstration; model not attempted.

should.requirement: Mentions the ZF temperature scan and that its integral asymmetry barely changes from 300 to 440 K, or says it was not analysed.

should.evidence: Stored scan/series JSON directories and named decisive PNGs provided.

corannulene-alc.root_cause: Repairs model-selection regression: local dip candidates trigger real ALC fits and whole-background explanation. Cold comparison still fails: agent reuses a narrow hot window for broad cold structure and stops at coverage/width limitations rather than widening independently. Conservative span/4 default width bounds also truncate broad solution fits in benzene. Separate fit-search bounds from the stricter flank criterion for calling a resonance resolved, and offer a concrete broader-window/Cubic investigation for truncated lines. Copy fails by replacing 14,828.1 G with 14.83 kG after audit.
